title: Story Project Core & Manuscript Structure
selected_by_owner: 2026-10-04 owner directed Continue after CWKS-05 while explicitly keeping AI writing/generation out of the current chain. The approved CWKS document architecture identifies Story Projects as the next later CWKS subsystem after document durability.
objective: Design the shared non-AI Story Project core that composes durable CreatorDocumentV1 documents into flexible manuscript/story structures without forcing a Series → Book → Part → Chapter → Scene chain and without taking ownership from existing Project, narrative-planning, Campaign, sequential-art, or other canonical domains.

include: flexible story-project/manuscript hierarchy with stable story-node identity
optional semantic node kinds such as series, book, part, chapter and scene without a mandatory hierarchy chain
chapter/scene and other prose-bearing nodes may reference existing CWKS documentId values rather than duplicate document content
deterministic parent/child ordering, move/reorder semantics and hierarchy validation
manuscript navigation/projection contracts and boundaries for later multi-document composition
explicit authority boundaries against APW/D26 Project/time, CSW narrative-plan/storycraft, Campaign runtime truth and SAA comic-project ownership
bounded design, focused contract plan and acceptance criteria before implementation authority is granted
exclude: AI writing, generation or AI knowledge assistance
wiki backlinks, aliases, transclusion or knowledge graph
visual corkboard, storyboard, timeline or plot-board UI
collaborative editing, comments or named version-history UI
GPR Session Service or CASI semantic-appearance implementation
application implementation until the CWKS-06 written design is explicitly approved

dependencies.completed_predecessor: CWKS-05 published as application main ad833c5ad7b0e309657bb80f628d8fd7bdb9002b after exact-head validation run 37128330215 and READY reconciliation at app queue generation 72
dependencies.authority_boundaries: APW/D26 retains generic Project/time authority; CSW retains creator storycraft/narrative-planning authority; Campaign/Session owners retain runtime truth; SAA retains comic project/page/panel/layer semantics.
dependencies.parallel_lane_rule: GPR PCV-03F and CASI-01 remain independently in_progress; CWKS-06 design may not modify or borrow either implementation branch.

next_action: Produce and review the bounded CWKS-06 Story Project Core design. Implementation remains unauthorized until the owner explicitly approves the written design.
